mapper.select: select NVL(A.VALUATION,0) from ( SELECT fpv.VALUATION,fpv.VAL_DATE FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpv LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = fpv.FINPROD_ID AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = fpv.FINPROD_TYPE2 WHERE fp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fpv.VAL_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') order by fpv.VAL_DATE desc )A where rownum = 1
select PROD_REGIST_CODE from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T1 inner join FIN_PRODUCT T2 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{product} and T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId}
